subject: Eval sandbox commissioning: API keys, org setup, IP allowlist & VPC peering timeline
messages:

Cc: Suresh Malhotra <suresh@novumhealth.com>, ops@novumhealth.com
Date: 2028-04-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: trial sandbox commissioning & rollout cadence

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Novum is ready to move from evaluation to a short trial where we can validate latency and cost for our clinical summarization pipeline. To keep the MAP tight and avoid delays on our side, can you confirm Redwood's recommended sequence and estimated lead times for the environment commissioning items below?

- Org/tenant creation and RBAC for two pilot users
- API keys (scoped to eval project) and rotation guidance
- IP allowlist entries for our egress subnets (we'll provide ranges)
- VPC peering setup (we're on Azure; would like peering with a shared subnet)
- Any required network ACLs or firewall openings for health data transfer testing

We're aiming to complete the infra handoff and start workload tests by the week of Apr 16. If you can attach a one-page MAP-style checklist with owners and target dates, we can sync it into our procurement schedule.

Appreciate a quick runbook and point contacts for the peering window.

Best,
Mei
Sr. IT Project Manager
Novum Health

Mei — thanks, this is clear and aligned with our typical MAP. I've attached a compact commissioning matrix (owners, deliverables, target dates). High-level proposal:

- Apr 5 (today): Confirm contact list + IP ranges from Novum (you) — DONE when you reply with ranges and peering admin contact
- Apr 6–8: Redwood creates eval org & service account, issues scoping notes for API keys (hours: 24–48)
- Apr 9–11: Network prep — we provide peering template and our Azure peering CIDR suggestions; Novum schedules peering (target 48–72h to complete once both sides accept)
- Apr 12: API keys issued to pilot service accounts; initial smoke tests
- Apr 16: Begin workload tests (as requested)

Owners: Redwood infra (Aditya) will own the peering template and support during the peering window. Neha will manage account-level RBAC and key scoping. Rachel will track MAP milestones and procurement gating.

Attaching: Sandbox-commissioning-matrix.xlsx and a MAP commitments summary PDF. If Novum needs an expedited path (e.g., dedicated connector or separate VPC with static egress), we can scope a dedicated onboarding plan but that will add ~1 week.

Next steps: Mei, send the IP ranges + peering admin contact and preferred maintenance window (we recommend evenings PDT to avoid blocking business users).

Thanks — I'll send a calendar invite for a 30-min technical sync once we have the ranges.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova

Mei — quick technical notes / checklist so your network team has everything in one place: 

1) API keys and org setup
   - We will create an eval org and two service accounts. Keys are minted with project scope only. Key rotation: manual + 30-day recommended rotation; we can automate later.
   - Deliverable: key manifest (names, scopes) delivered as a staged secret (we'll share via secure link).

2) IP allowlist
   - Please provide CIDRs for outbound egress and any NATed subnets. We'll add to our allowlist and confirm once propagated. Propagation takes ~1–2 hours after entry.

3) VNet/VPC peering (Azure)
   - We'll provide a peering template containing our peer CIDRs and required route table changes. Typical steps: accept peering on both sides, update routes, validate BGP/AS details if present. Expect 24–72 hours depending on change window.

4) Ports/ACLs
   - TLS-based traffic to Redwood endpoints (443). No additional custom ports required for API traffic. If you plan to run telemetry ingestion, we can advise specific ports.

5) Test plan
   - 1) Connectivity sanity check (ping, TLS handshake)
   - 2) Token authentication test using scoped key
   - 3) Small throughput test (1000 tokens/min equivalent) to validate latency targets

If Novum prefers we perform the peering steps as a managed assist (we drive the accept/update on Redwood side while your team accepts), we can schedule that during your maintenance window.

I'll stand by during the peering window.

—Aditya
Senior Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
